summary: Tested Restart Setup feature end-to-end (backend + UI). All requested checks pass: Settings > You & your career shows restart-setup-card; dialog opens, 'Keep using FMCC' closes it with state unchanged; 'Open setup' shows Setup wizard with restart wording and setup-cancel-restart; /api/state shows setup_complete=false, setup_restart=true, career TEST_Shot/TEST FC kept; wizard navigation (setup-next-1, setup-back-2, setup-next-2 to step 3, setup-step-1) works in restart mode and the cancel button stays visible on steps 1-3; reload mid-restart keeps the restart wizard; setup-cancel-restart returns to Shell with same career (top bar TEST FC) and setup_complete=true, setup_restart=false. POST /api/setup/cancel when not restarted returns 409 (also a second cancel after a successful cancel). POST /api/setup/complete was intercepted/aborted - 0 calls made, no career created. Preview left with setup_complete=true.

issues: Step 1 defaults still say 'Sample Club FC' / 'My first career' in restart mode; a 'My second career'-style or blank default would read better (cosmetic)
URL stays /settings?section=career while the wizard is shown (harmless; the user goes back to Settings after cancel)

critical_code_review_comments: Setup.jsx cancel(): no busy/disabled guard, so a double-click sends two POST /setup/cancel calls and the second shows a 409 error toast. Minor.
setup_api.restart_setup returns ok:true without doing anything when setup_complete is already false. Harmless, but the wizard then won't show restart mode if setup_restart is missing.
seed_data_creation: None. Restart was run several times and cancelled each time; the active career (TEST_Shot) is unchanged and no new career was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Restart/cancel is safe to test for real: always finish with POST /api/setup/cancel. setup-next-1 only appears after clicking setup-detect-button (Scan). Block **/api/setup/complete with page.route so no career is created.
